result.title: Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks
result.summary: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction. When these models fail, there is no mechanism to correct their mistakes. To address this limitation, we introduce Click3R, a framework for interactive geometric correction of feed-forward models using sparse human correspondence clicks. Given an image pair and a small set of cross-view point correspondences provided by a user, Click3R injects geometric constraints into the 3D reconstruction networks through a lightweight point correspondence adapter, enabling the model to resolve ambiguities in challenging scenarios such as repetitive textures, symmetric structures, large viewpoint changes, or textureless regions. To evaluate interactive reconstruction, we curate a challenging benchmark specifically designed to expose failure modes of existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods. Experiments show that Click3R reduces reconstruction error with as few as a single correspondence click, improving performance on both standard and our curated benchmarks. Our results highlight that sparse human interaction provides an effective and practical mechanism for correcting geometric reconstruction errors.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Click3R，用少量用户标注的跨视角对应点击，通过轻量 point correspondence adapter 向 feed-forward 3D 重建网络注入几何约束，实现可交互纠错，并构建专门暴露现有方法失败模式的基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 「用极稀疏的外部证据点击改写网络内部表示以纠正错误」这一机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何筛选并写入 latent 状态、以及最小证据干预的代价收益提供启发性对照；但任务本身是几何重建而非多模态推理，联系需较多核查。
